content.title: Browse the enterprise product catalog
content.description: A Buyer or Procurement Manager browses the account-specific catalog of hardware products, sees each product's category, image, starting price, and availability state, can branch into configuration for configurable devices or add non-configurable items directly to a quote, and is prevented from quoting end-of-life products while being shown a recommended replacement by name.
content.summary: Find eligible products for a quote.
content.value: Lets enterprise purchasers discover which products their account can quote and whether they can be configured or directly added.
criteria: Each product card shows product name, category, and image, where category values are Laptop, Workstation, Tablet, and Accessory.
Each product card shows a starting price using "From $X" for configurable products.
Availability states are In Stock, Backorder — ships in N days when stock is zero, and End of Life.
Configurable products use a Configure action for laptops and workstations, while non-configurable products use Add to Quote for accessories and tablets.
End-of-life products show a grey End of Life badge, cannot be added to a quote, and show the recommended replacement product by name.
